name: @gjsify/napi-linux-x64
description: linux-x64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/napi. Installed automatically on linux/x64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.linux-x64: napi.yml's Fedora jobs rebuild it and gate on it, and release.yml's `napi-prebuild-linux` job rebuilds it from the released tag for a release to ship; no job commits it back into this repo
